sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 16 and Internal Quality Checks row 16 (environment_does_not_leak_the_answer; no extra internal annotation columns populated)
task/tests/app_context.md, tests/gates/*/{judge.toml,prompt.md}, tests/scored/*/{judge.toml,prompt.md}, tests/scoring.toml (10-gram overlap scan)
evidence: Agent image cannot hold the deliverable: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty; sha256 0a75419e...) and only does 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/', then mkdir /app, git init, 'touch /app/.gitkeep' and commits it, so /app holds only .gitkeep; the build context environment/ contains just the Dockerfile, seed_data.json and six instruction notes, so solution/ and tests/ are unreachable. task/environment/assets/seed_data.json is 149 bytes: '{"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."}' - no starter, schema or route list; instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 state there is no starter app. The six notes are user-voice behaviour specs (no code, no CREATE TABLE, no route list beyond the required GET /api/health contract in integration.md:3, which is a runtime fact not an answer). Grep for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe over the notes and brief returns only that /api/health line; a word 10-gram overlap scan of instruction.md + notes + seed against app_context.md, every gate/scored prompt.md and judge.toml and scoring.toml finds 0 shared 10-grams, so no criterion text is reproduced. Counterexample probe: an agent that ships the image untouched (nop) would have nothing to serve; the raw-evidence-index records hosted v15 nop = 0 with no_op=1 (same environment/ semantics), consistent with no leaked deliverable. A conforming alternative build is not disadvantaged since nothing in /instructions dictates routes, schema or selectors (policy.md:3-5). Limitation: I did not rebuild and inspect the v16 agent image in Docker; the verdict rests on the static Dockerfile/build-context analysis, which is conclusive for this row because COPY sources are limited to the two listed directories.
